whatIs: BG.IBELICK is a collection of backgrounds ready to paste into a page. Each card has a preview and a button to copy the code, available in Tailwind CSS and plain CSS, designed for full-page backgrounds.
It's a good fit when you want a modern background (gradients, grids, glows) without designing it or installing anything.
uses: Give a Tailwind project's landing page a subtle gradient background.
Replace the flat background of a documentation page with a grid one.
Take a snippet as a starting point and adjust its colors to your brand.
caveats: They're fixed snippets, not a generator with controls: to change colors or sizes you have to edit the code.
They're designed as full-page backgrounds; to use them in a single section you'll have to adjust the positioning.
pricingNote: No account or paid plans; you copy straight from the site.
idealFor: Tailwind projects that want a nice background in a couple of minutes.
